{"type":"custom","name":"acp_available_commands_update","data":{"truncated":true,"preview":"{\"type\":\"custom\",\"name\":\"acp_available_commands_update\",\"data\":{\"availableCommands\":[{\"name\":\"acceptmarkdown-compliance\",\"description\":\"How to verify acceptmarkdown.com (RFC 9110 markdown content negotiation) compliance on Desplega Labs landing/doc sites. Use when reviewing a PR that touches middleware/proxy/edge config, Next.js headers, or /md/ and /llms.txt routes on any public site. Also use when shipping a new landing or doc site — it must be compliant before going live.\"},{\"name\":\"agent-browser\",\"description\":\"Drive a real browser with the agent-browser CLI (headless Chromium over CDP). Use for any browser task: verifying a UI change, taking a screenshot, walking a web page, filling a form, extracting page text, reproducing a frontend bug, or attaching UI evidence to a PR, issue, Linear comment, or Slack thread. Starts with a `command -v agent-browser` check and falls back to manual QA on the slim worker image. Screenshots are shared through agent-fs signed URLs. This is the only browser automation tool; do not use qa-use.\"},{\"name\":\"agent-fs\",\"description\":\"How to use agent-fs — the swarm's persistent, searchable, shared filesystem — for thoughts, research, plans, and any document a human or another agent should read. CRITICAL distinction agents keep getting wrong — there are TWO hosts: the fly.dev URL is the agent-fs API (raw REST backend), and live.agent-fs.dev is the UI for sharing human-clickable links. Use whenever you write/read research, plans, or brainstorms; need to share a file with a human; or see an agent documenting agent-fs with the wrong URL. Prefer the `agent-fs` CLI over raw REST and over the local /workspace/shared/thoughts path.\"},{\"name\":\"agent-swarm-info\",\"description\":\"Operational reference for the agent-swarm product — the agent swarm framework for AI coding agents (agent-swarm.dev). Use when a task concerns agent-swarm code, its landing site, or its cloud/SaaS offering. agent-swarm is a separate product from desplega.ai — do not conflate them. For the full company structure see desplega-company-info.\"},{\"name\":\"agent-swarm-page-branding\",\"description\":\"MANDATORY brand rules for every page, dashboard, or HTML artifact the swarm publishes — Agent Swarm tokens (shadcn Zinc + amber-700 primary, Space Grotesk / Space Mono, the honeycomb logo) in LIGHT MODE ONLY. Use this whenever you call create_page, build an HTML report/dashboard, render a hero/OG image, or review someone else's page. It OVERRIDES the generic \\\"warm monochrome / SF Pro / Geist\\\" palette in the `pages` and `taste-minimalist-skill` skills. Also defines the agent-browser verification gate before you hand a page link to a human.\"},{\"name\":\"agent-swarm-prepush-gates\",\"description\":\"Read BEFORE pushing to desplega-ai/agent-swarm. Three pre-push gate failures in that repo are environmental or phantom, not your diff — one orphaned-sqlite freeze, one standing test failure on clean main that CI passes, and a Docker \\\"gate\\\" that is not a hook and cannot run in any swarm container. Prevents holding a complete, review-clean PR against an unsatisfiable check. Never resolve any of them with --no-verify.\"},{\"name\":\"agent-swarm-release-x-post\",\"description\":\"End-to-end playbook for turning a new agent-swarm GitHub release into an on-brand X/Twitter post for @desplegalabs. Use whenever a new agent-swarm release ships and someone asks to \\\"post the release on X\\\", \\\"do a release post\\\", \\\"release notes on X\\\", \\\"tweet the new version\\\", or \\\"make a release video for X\\\". Chains three existing skills: swarm-studio (render the Hive creative), x-posting-guidelines (the @desplegalabs voice), and x-api-interactions (post + self-reply). This is a LIVING skill — append to the Iteration Log at the bottom every time it runs.\"},{\"name\":\"agenticos-daily-review\",\"description\":\"Run the unattended r/AgenticOS daily open-source repository review series end to end. Use when an agent must select the next queued repo, produce a code-sourced dossier and three-takeaway post, calculate the fixed nine metrics, run the deterministic voice/structure gate, render and host the metrics grid, park the gated draft for Eze to publish by hand, or reconcile AgenticOS series state in KV. The swarm does NOT publish posts to Reddit.\"},{\"name\":\"agentmail-sending\",\"description\":\"CRITICAL rules for sending emails via AgentMail API. Covers the HTML bug workaround, BCC policy, and best practices. ALL agents MUST follow these rules when using send_message or reply_to_message.\"},{\"name\":\"ai-seo\",\"description\":\"When the user wants to optimize content for AI search engines, get cited by LLMs, or appear in AI-generated answers. Also use when the user mentions 'AI SEO,' 'AEO,' 'GEO,' 'LLMO,' 'answer engine optimization,' 'generative engine optimization,' 'LLM optimization,' 'AI Overviews,' 'optimize for ChatGPT,' 'optimize for Perplexity,' 'AI citations,' 'AI visibility,' 'zero-click search,' 'how do I show up in AI answers,' 'LLM mentions,' 'optimize for Claude/Gemini,' 'llms.txt,' 'OKF,' 'Open Knowledge Format,' 'knowledge bundle,' or 'agent-readable site.' Use this whenever someone wants their content to be cited or surfaced by AI assistants and AI search engines. For traditional technical and on-page SEO audits, see seo-audit. For structured data implementation, see schema.\"},{\"name\":\"apps\",\"description\":\"Build and iterate on schema-backed Swarm Apps with live models, named queries, custom actions, and json-render interfaces using the app-upsert, app-get, app-list, and app-patch tools.\"},{\"name\":\"artifacts\",\"description\":\"Store durable task outputs (reports, screenshots, exports, logs) in agent-fs or the shared workspace, and serve interactive web content to a public auth-protected URL via localtunnel. Use when asked to save evidence for a PR/ticket, share a file, \\\"create an artifact for X\\\", \\\"host this for me\\\", \\\"spin up a web server\\\", or \\\"give me a live link\\\". Covers agent-fs writes and verification, binary uploads, naming and attachment conventions, the `agent-swarm artifact` CLI, Hono apps, PM2 daemonization, HTTP Basic auth, and the injected browser SDK.\"},{\"name\":\"asb-positioning\",\"description\":\"Converts marketing copy — headlines, ads, homepage claims, pitches, positioning statements — into value-first, vivid language: reframes save-time/save-money pitches as create-more-value pitches in the currency the customer measures value, fits each claim to the right level of the customer's needs (features at your level, the promise one level up, aspirations referenced but never promised, obviated steps bragged about), keeps every claim consistent with the declared pricing strategy (More for More, More for Less, or Less for Less), and forces specificity — no generic words, no clichés, show-don't-tell, real numbers only, claims passing the Opposite Test. Works one message at a time, recording survivors in POSITIONING.md. Sharper with an ideal-customer definition and a needs stack; works without. Load when the user wants marketing copy, positioning, headlines, or a pitch rewritten, sharpened, or audited. Do NOT load to build the needs stack or define the ideal customer — upstream steps this skill consumes.\"},{\"name\":\"asb-problem\",\"description\":\"Scores whether a business idea can become a viable business, walking the path from 'The Problem' to 'Viable Business Model': one specific target market is Fermi-scored on seven multiplying criteria (Plausible, Self-Aware, Lucrative, Liquid, Eager ×2, Enduring), every optimistic number is challenged unless evidence backs it, and when the verdict is bad, narrower niches are re-scored side by side. Load when the user asks whether their startup or product idea is viable, whether a market really exists for what they want to build, why a product that solves a real problem isn't selling, which of several target markets to pursue, whether to persevere or give up on a product, or says 'score my idea.' Do NOT load for general devil's-advocate stress-testing of plans or pitches without the viability question, for building a full ideal-customer profile, for writing customer-interview questions, or for execution problems like funnel optimization, hiring, or fundraising.\"},{\"name\":\"ask-user\",\"description\":\"Conventions for asking the user questions during a workflow via the AskUserQuestion tool. Other skills reference this to keep prompts consistent and structured.\"},{\"name\":\"asset-namespaces\",\"description\":\"Use canonical asset namespace keys to group, find, inherit, and move tasks, workflows, schedules, pages, and mapped files. Use when organizing swarm work under shared/ or personal/{userId}/ paths, setting or filtering asset keys, or calling the asset-management API.\"},{\"name\":\"attio-interaction\",\"description\":\"Generic Attio CRM REST API v2 recipes for querying records, upserting companies/people/deals, writing notes/tasks/comments, managing lists, and handling webhooks.\"},{\"name\":\"brainstorming\",\"description\":\"Interactive exploration of ideas through Socratic Q&A. Produces progressive documents that serve as lightweight pre-PRDs feeding into research.\"},{\"name\":\"browser-interaction\",\"description\":\"The swarm's browser tool is `agent-browser` — Taras's standing instruction of 2026-08-24, \\\"use agent browser from now on\\\". Use this whenever a task needs a real browser: verifying a published page or dashboard, screenshots at desktop + mobile widths, reading console/page errors, clicking through a UI, filling a form, scraping a JS-rendered site, or checking a deploy looks right. It replaces qa-use, raw Playwright/Puppeteer snippets, and ad-hoc headless-Chrome scripts. Contains the empirically verified commands, the container's Chromium path, the page-verification gate, and the two narrow cases where you escalate to Browser Use Cloud instead.\"},{\"name\":\"browser-use-cloud\",\"description\":\"How to drive a real cloud browser via the Browser Use Cloud API to extract content from sites that block the swarm's datacenter IP (YouTube \\\"Sign in to confirm you'r… [truncated]"}}
